comment: Modes family: solve modes / solution algorithms / input formats / executive verbs (Set mode=Time/LD1/LD2/M1/M2/M3/MF/AutoAdd, algorithm=Newton, binary/CSV shape-file inputs, harmonic-curve elements and harmonics-mode element decks, BatchEdit, Reduce), live-compared by modes_cases_match_oracle. Absorbed from the former gaps/ staging family (GAPS_PLAN.md section 3.1): every deck was oracle-validated at creation (two-process determinism + feature sensitivity, pinned dss-python 0.15.7); every case stays pending=true (the gate asserts the Rust engine errors loudly) until the WP named in its wp field ports the feature and flips the flag. n_steps = solve sample points observed on the oracle. Multi-file cases live in a subfolder named after the deck; the shape_binfiles binary/CSV fixtures regenerate via tools/decks/gen_shape_fixtures.py, the midi_* decks via tools/decks/gen_midi_decks.py.

cases.notes: WPG.1 audit follow-up: ls_sng0i pins the single-precision interpolation + Mean/StdDev single stats; t_sng0 the ScalarShapeCore pair branch; g_csvf fractional CSV years (DoCSVFile ignores RoundA); g_sng the Sng-side year rounding.

WPG.17 LoadShape MemoryMapping=Yes + Set/Get TotalTime. Self-contained (no var, no non-MM File=). sngfile/dblfile/raw mult=(sngfile=) MMF are fixed-interval = I/O-only (numerically identical to non-MM, exercising the sng/dbl/raw MMF readers); the ls_pq shape is the feature axis: its P column is exponent notation and the MMF text accept-set drops sign/exponent, so ld_pq draws 501 kW (P mult 5.01) at hour 8 under MMF vs 50 kW (0.50) without it. Under MMF the array props dump the (<directive>) round-trip. Oracle-validated (pinned dss-python 0.15.7): compiles+solves+converges; AllBusVmag fingerprint bit-identical across TWO separate oracle processes (38c28c752fa5ecae); feature-sensitive — flipping MemoryMapping off the pq shape changes the fingerprint to e363c3929e7d692f (ld_pq_P 167->16.7 W/phase). The trailing Set/Get totaltime exercises the option surface (inert for the compared fingerprint).

WPG.19 non-memory-mapped file-backed numeric arrays (Pascal InterpretDblArray, Common/Utilities.pas:461-566) for array properties WITHOUT MemoryMapping=Yes — the last blocker of the ckt24 MemoryMappingLoadShapes family (LS_PhaseB/C use mult=(file=...) action=normalize). Covers, on a LoadShape: mult=(file=) single column, column=2 (1-based), header=yes (skip 1 line), sngfile=/dblfile= inline binary directives, a short file (5 rows, npts=8) that shrinks NumPoints to 5 (Pascal Result:=i-1), and action=normalize which runs AFTER the file read (fa_norm peak 2.0 -> mult /2 = [0.25 0.5 1 0.75 0.4 0.2 0.6 0.3]). SITE 2 (generic DSSObjectHelper double-array path): Spectrum %mag=(file=) and XYcurve Yarray=(file=). Oracle-validated (pinned dss-python 0.15.7): compiles+solves+converges (2 iters); full fingerprint (converged/iters, YNodeVarray, 7 monitor channel sets, loadshape npts+mult, Spectrum %mag/NumHarm, XYcurve Yarray) bit-identical across TWO separate oracle processes (6225f27521de809e); feature-sensitive — stripping every mult=(file=) directive leaves empty shapes and the daily solve raises an access violation on the oracle (materially different). Fixtures regenerate via tools/decks/gen_shape_filearr_fixtures.py.

cases.note: PeakDay Load daily-shape fix: the load current follows day8 exactly (|I1| = mult x 300A: 120/165/225/285/300/270/210/150) and PeakDay applies NO LoadMultiplier (peak 300A not 450A despite Set LoadMult=1.5). Feature-sensitive vs a flat shape (monitor channels + meter registers diverge); the missing-calc_daily_mult bug would sit flat at nominal. Oracle-validated (dss-python 0.15.7): bit-identical across two processes.

Set mode=direct + the TPCElement.GetCurrents LastSolutionWasDirect shortcut (PCElement.pas l.137): snapshot solve first (flag cleared by DoPFLOWsolution), then a direct solve; reported Load currents/powers must be the frozen shadow-admittance YPrim*Vterminal (CalcYPrimContribution), not the model conj(S/V). Feature-sensitive well above band: on ld1 the shortcut gives I1=(36.3266,-12.6335) |I1|=38.461 A / P1=259.493 kW vs model 39.540 A / 266.665 kW (~1.1 A, ~7.2 kW per phase); omitting the shortcut reproduces the old escalated divergence. Oracle-validated (dss-python 0.15.7): converged, 1 iteration, bit-identical across two processes. Probe facts: Set mode=direct WITHOUT solve does NOT flip currents; a snapshot solve after direct reverts to model currents; Set loadmodel=admittance + Solve in snap mode takes the same shortcut (SolveCircuit->SolveDirect); Powers read before Currents shows no order dependence.

WPG.5: AutoAdd capacity search. Oracle segfaults at PROCESS EXIT after the solve (solve completes; captured before teardown by the one-shot oracle subprocess, whose post-output exit code is ignored). Winner probe-pinned Text.Result="b3, 0.0180069930672805"; Generator.gadd1 probe + final voltages + AutoAddLog compared. See GAPS_PLAN.md 2.2.

WPG.5 audit (Major): the CAPADD (addtype=capacitor) branch of TAutoAdd.Solve — completely ungated until now (autoadd.dss covers only GENADD). Exercises the per-candidate Ycap shunt injection, the winner emission `New Capacitor.cadd1`, GetUniqueCapName, and the <case>_AutoAddedCapacitors.txt append. Oracle-validated (dss-python 0.15.7, two separate processes bit-identical): Text.Result="b2" (CAPADD GlobalResult is the winner bus NAME only, no improvement figure — AutoAdd.pas l.560); Capacitor.cadd1 = bus1 b2 / 3ph / kvar 600 / kv 12.47; AutoAddLog rows b1/b2/b3 (b2 max weighted). Same PROCESS-EXIT segfault as autoadd.dss (captured before teardown). Feature-sensitive: if the CAPADD branch no-ops, no cadd1 is added (probe fails) and GlobalResult goes empty.

Set algorithm=Newton (Pascal DoNewtonSolution): the current-injection algorithm on the light 3-bus feeder. Oracle-validated (dss-python 0.15.7): converged, 2 iterations, bit-identical across two processes. The gate pins the full model (converged flag, iteration count, voltages, I/P/L). NOTE: Newton and the normal fixed-point converge to the SAME voltages in the SAME iteration count, so the ONLY channel that distinguishes them is the post-Newton stale-Iterminal Powers/Losses split (TODO(compat) in exec/view.rs snapshot_elements) — that is what actually verifies Newton dispatch is wired.

WPG.6 second Newton case: a 115/12.47 kV transformer feeder with stressed constant-power loads, re-solved under algorithm=Newton. Oracle-validated (dss-python 0.15.7): converged, 3 iterations (vs 2 for newton.dss), bit-identical across two processes. Its value over newton.dss is the distinct topology (2-winding transformer + mixed 3ph/1ph constant-power loads) under the Newton path — not the iteration count, which does not distinguish Newton from the normal algorithm (see newton.dss note).
Harmonics case: the second Solve sweeps harmonics 1/5/7 (3 monitor samples). Feature-sensitive probe-proven: removing rcurve/lcurve shifts the harmonic monitor channels ~0.6%.

XYcurve CSVFile/SngFile/DblFile file-input props: rc.csv, lc.sng, rc2.dbl feed three curves into two series reactors' rcurve/lcurve; harmonics solve (1/5/7 -> 3 monitor samples). GAPS-3 oracle-validated (dss-python 0.15.7): compiles+solves+converges clean; bit-identical monitor fingerprint across two separate oracle processes (50ba0afb...); feature-sensitive (dropping rcurve/lcurve changes the fingerprint), and a same-values xarray/yarray deck reproduces the file-fed fingerprint bit-for-bit (readers parse the intended values). Fixtures from tools/decks/gen_xycurve_fixtures.py.
Harmonics case: the second Solve sweeps the collected frequencies (7 monitor samples on the oracle - scan5 harmonics 1/5/7/11 merged with the defaultload spectrum 1/3/5/7/9/11/13).

TRegExpr selection semantics: pattern `LA` (case-insensitive, UNANCHORED partial match, ExecHelper.pas:319-328) edits la1/la2/xla1 but not lb1; `^lb` (anchored) edits lb1 only. Oracle-validated 2026-07-05: deterministic + feature-sensitive.
The same regex semantics at midi scale (94 nodes): `ld1` unanchored hits ld1+ld10..ld19 (11 loads), `^LD2$` hits ld2 only, `^l4` re-lengths the l4a/b/c run. Generated by gen_midi_decks.py.

DoReduceDefault in-line series merge: oracle result = Line.l1~l2 created (child renamed Other.Name+'~'+Name, Line.MergeWith SERIES), l1 disabled, b2 eliminated (15->12 nodes); b3 survives via the MarkCapandReactorBuses keep.

DoReduceShortLines under Set Zmag=0.1: oracle result = Line.s1~s2, s1 disabled, one bus eliminated (15->12 nodes); the load at the eliminated bus is re-parented by the bus1= re-edit (ReduceAlgs.pas:226/:277).
DoReduceDangling: the dead-end line ld1 (no shunts downstream) is disabled (d1 gone, 15->12 nodes); ld2 (feeds a load) survives.
DoReduceSwitches: in-line switch sw1 merged into the downstream non-switch l2 (b2 eliminated), dangling switch sw2 disabled (15->9 nodes).

DoRemoveAll_1ph_Laterals with default KeepLoad=Yes: lat1/lat3 disabled, their loads re-parented onto the head buses with kV=<head kVLN>; the lat2a/lat2b pair lands on shared bus x2 (2 nodes) and is SKIPPED (ReduceAlgs.pas:474). 16->14 nodes.
DoMergeParallelLines: the p1/p2 parallel pair merges into Line.b1||b2 (PARALLEL MergeWith: ParallelZ, C summed), p1 disabled. Node count unchanged - the Z change carries the sensitivity.
DoBreakLoops: the loop-closing line l4 is disabled (no merge). Node count unchanged - the V change carries the sensitivity.
The Set KeepList=(b2) guard (DoKeeperBusList -> Bus.Keep): the l1+l2 merge at b2 is BLOCKED, the l2+l3 merge at unkept b3 proceeds (15->12 nodes).

DoReduceDefault at midi scale (94->88 nodes): oracle merges l2a~l2b, l3a~l3b and the feeder-end bb14_15~l9a; loaded/branched buses survive; the loop tie and regulator bank stay. Generated by gen_midi_decks.py.

UPGRADE_PLAN.md WP-U0 pilot: keeps the per-case target-rev oracle machinery (Oddie r4133 engine binding, ping pin check, iteration policy Rust<=oracle) exercised by every cargo test. Deliberately revision-insensitive deck; validated per the WP-U0 protocol (two-process determinism on the r4133 engine).

UPGRADE_PLAN.md WP-U1.1 / ledger L2 (docs/upgrade/DIVERGENCES.md): EPRI r4133 DblValueNZ zero-kW clamp. Load kW=0 and Generator kVA=0/kW=0 clamp their essential-sizing props to 1e-8 (band (-1e-8,1e-8)->+1e-8). Gated r4133 because this deck declares Generator.kVA=0, which capi015's DEFAULT strict validation REJECTS (NonZero error) so the deck cannot compile there, while r4133 clamps by default (like the port) and oddie matches (re-probed 2026-07-12). Feature sensitivity (§1.7-3): the 1e-8 clamp is below the live i_abs floor on kw/kva/V/I/Y/S, so Load.zpf (kW=0 AND kvar=0) supplies an amplified channel -- under the clamp its kW/kvar spec recomputes PF 0.9->1, with no clamp PF stays 0.9; the ?pf probe (0.9 vs 1, |d|=0.1) fails if the clamp regresses. Bit-exact per-class contract = the Rust unit tests zero_kw_kva_clamp_dblvaluenz (Load/Generator/Storage) + zero_kva_clamp_dblvaluenz (PVSystem). Validated per §1.7 on r4133 (two-process determinism).

UPGRADE_PLAN.md WP-U1.6 / row B3-r3723 (docs/upgrade/DIVERGENCES.md): Load.GrowthFactor at Year=0 with a GrowthShape tracks simulated hours (calcYear=dblHour/8760) instead of a flat 1.0. The rewrite is in the capi015 backend 0.15.0b4 (SVN r4103, carrying the r4088-era Load.pas GrowthFactor change). Feature sensitivity (§1.7-3): the growthshape's first year is 0, so a Year=0 snapshot takes GetMultIdx(1)=1.2 -- a 20% load lift that needs no >8760h run for a single-step witness. capi015 reports Load.lb at 120 kW total (B1 |V|=7198.164683 V), the pre-B3 flat-1.0 path 100 kW (B1 |V|=7198.397078 V); |dP|=20 kW and |dV|=0.23 V are far above every live floor, so a regression to the flat Year=0 factor fails the whole-model compare (load power AND node voltages). Gated capi015 (not 0.14.5): the r3723 baseline and capi015 DIVERGE here so it cannot gate against 0.14.5 (§1.2). Validated per §1.7 (two-process determinism on capi015: bit-identical Vmag fingerprint, probe_deck.py 2026-07-16). Exact per-branch values (GetMultIdx(1)=1.2, GetMult(2)=1.8) pinned by the Rust unit test growth_factor_year0_tracks_simulated_hours_with_growthshape.
The `Remove` command (DoRemoveBranches, ReduceAlgs.pas:374) with KeepLoad=Yes: oracle disables l2/l3/ld3/ld4 and creates the equivalent Load.eq_l2_b2 at the FROM bus (15->9 nodes).

WP-PF.1: the IEC-868 `Pstcalc` executive command (ExecHelper.DoPstCalc over Shared/Pstcalc.pas). The deck solves a trivial 3-phase feeder, then runs one `Pstcalc` (700-point modulated-sine RMS array, dt=1 s, freq=60, 120 V lamp -> one 10-minute Pst value) at compile time. Live-gates that the command is ported and runs error-free on both engines (a not_ported/parse regression fails the post-compile no-error assert) plus the standard full-model compare. compare_global_result is deliberately NOT set (audit WP-PF.1): the harness captures GlobalResult only AFTER its own solve, which clears the Pstcalc result on both engines, so the flag would compare empty-vs-empty and gate nothing. The byte-exact Pst-value comparison over the full npts/shape/lamp/freq/dt matrix is the golden `golden_pstcalc.rs` (tests/golden/pstcalc/cmd_results.json).

MakePosSequence Line coverage: symcomponents (l_sym keeps Z1: r1=0.301 x1=0.667 c1=3.4 normamps=400), rmatrix/xmatrix (l_mat Z averaged to positive seq r1=0.21 x1=0.6), geometry, spacing+wires, switch=yes (l_sw fixed switch consts r1=1 x1=1 c1=1.1), 1-phase, units=mi. All lines -> phases=1, bus dots stripped. Oracle-validated (dss-python 0.15.7, two processes bit-identical; converged 2 iters, 8 nodes); feature-sensitive vs the deck with `makeposseq` removed. Pending until WPG.21 A2 wires the dispatch.

MakePosSequence Transformer/AutoTrans coverage: 2w (sub) + 3w (t3) transformers and an AutoTrans -> phases=1, per-winding kV=kVLL/SQRT3 (sub kvs=[66.3953, 7.19956]) and kVA/phases (sub kvas=[6666.67, 6666.67]), conns all wye. 1-phase xfmr on .1 (t1_ok) survives; 1-phase xfmr on .2 (t1_off) is NOT on phase 1 -> Enabled:=FALSE (the OnPhase1 disable path, Transformer.pas:1698) and keeps its dotted buses b1.2/b6.2 (base rename skipped after the early Exit). Oracle-validated (dss-python 0.15.7, two processes bit-identical; converged 4 iters, 6 nodes); feature-sensitive. Pending until WPG.21 A2.

MakePosSequence shunt coverage: Capacitor SpecType 1 (kvar 600 -> [200], kV 12.47 -> 7.19956), 2 (cuf), 3 (cmatrix); Reactor SpecType 1 (kvar 200 -> 66.667), 2 (R+jX kept), 3 (rmatrix/xmatrix averaged R=0.26667 X=3), 4 (Z1 sym); Fault; GICTransformer. All -> phases=1; cap/reactor/fault/GICxfmr default grounded bus2 gets the IsGroundBus `.0` re-append (e.g. cap_kvar bus2=b1.0). Oracle-validated (dss-python 0.15.7, two processes bit-identical; converged 2 iters, 3 nodes); feature-sensitive. Pending until WPG.21 A2.

MakePosSequence PC coverage: Load wye/delta+xfkVA/1ph (ld_wye kv 12.47->7.19956, kw 400->44.444), Generator x4 exercising the PrpSequence reads (g_plain kW+pf; g_kva kVA=250 kept; g_mva MVA=; g_kvar maxkvar 120->40 / minkvar -60->-20, ALL /phases), PVSystem, Storage, 2nd VSource, Isource. Ends with a SECOND makeposseq+solve (idempotency + the ÷3-again quirk). VSConverter DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED (its upstream GetCurrents state-mutating bug forbids a live full-model compare, CLAUDE.md known-bugs); its MakePosSequence override is NOT a no-op (it forces Phases:=2, Ndc:=1 when nphases!=2) and is covered by the pos_seq_tests unit test in pc/vs_converter/accessors.rs. Oracle-validated (dss-python 0.15.7, two processes bit-identical; converged 3 iters, 4 nodes); feature-sensitive. Pending until WPG.21 A2.

MakePosSequence control/metering coverage: EnergyMeter, Monitor (mode 0 and 1), Sensor, CapControl+cap, RegControl+xfmr, Relay/Recloser/SwtControl on lines, StorageController -- all targets resolvable, DERs/monitored elements created BEFORE their controls (DoMakePosSeq converts in creation order). InvControl/ExpControl/GenDispatcher/ESPVLControl/UPFCControl DELIBERATELY ABSENT: their overrides deref a NIL element and abort the oracle with an Access violation (docs/wpg21_makeposseq_probes.md) -> WT-D safe-skip unit tests, never decks. Oracle-validated (dss-python 0.15.7, two processes bit-identical; converged 5 iters, 6 nodes); feature-sensitive. Pending until WPG.21 A2.

MakePosSequence end-to-end report path: a mixed mini feeder (115/12.47 sub xfmr + 3 lines + cap + mixed loads + meter + monitor) solve -> makeposseq -> solve -> report reads (summary/losses/monitor sample) that exercise the PositiveSequence x3 power paths (Get_Power/Get_Losses/summary scale by 3). Oracle-validated (dss-python 0.15.7, two processes bit-identical; converged 4 iters, 5 nodes); feature-sensitive. Pending until WPG.21 A2.

SolveMode=DAILYMODE (Pascal SolveDaily, SolutionAlgs.pas:160): the 24-step daily loop that GENERALTIME (single-step) and PEAKDAY (ignores LoadMult) do not cover. `Set LoadMult=1.2` IS applied to the loads in DAILY (nominal.rs:138-141, `f *= load_multiplier`), SampleTheMeters+DI open/close, EndOfTimeStepCleanup + a trailing IncrementTime per step; the 24 solves walk hours 0..23. Oracle-validated: 24 converged steps, bit-identical across two processes (d4bde52ae6197a1c); feature-sensitive vs LoadMult=1.0 (5008550ad64a3c2e — every monitor/meter channel shifts).

SolveMode=DAILYMODE at stepsize=7200s (2h) to reach the IncrementTime multi-decrement branch (`while t>=3600 do begin t-=3600; intHour++ end` runs TWICE/step) — unreachable at h<=3600, so no other modes deck covers it. The 12 solves sample hours 2,4,...,24. Oracle-validated: 12 converged steps, bit-identical across two processes (c5e11c7486c85a51); feature-sensitive vs stepsize=3600 (c93630d4dc1234c8 — hours 1..12, one decrement/step).

SolveMode=YEARLYMODE (Pascal SolveYearly, SolutionAlgs.pas:112): the DefaultYearlyShapeObj.GetMultAtHour channel (loads carry `yearly=`, scaled by growth×LoadMult like every mode, nominal.rs:146-148 — the deck leaves LoadMult at its default 1.0) and the `if PriceCurveObj<>NIL then PriceSignal:=GetPrice(dblHour)` arm (SolutionAlgs.pas:136). PriceSignal drives a price-dispatched Generator (dispmode=price, Generator.pas:1090) whose YEARLY generator dispatch reference omits LoadMultiplier (gf*hm, power_flow.rs:284): g_pk runs ALL year (curve 50..80 >= dispvalue=40) with the curve present, and stays OFF without it (PriceSignal holds its default 25 < 40). dispvalue sits above the default 25 but below every curve price so the split is steady ON vs steady OFF (a mid-run flip would cost the oracle an extra convergence iteration on the flip step). Oracle-validated: 8 converged steps (2 iters each), bit-identical across two processes (b7fca76ea63c5cd6); feature-sensitive two ways — removing PriceCurve leaves g_pk OFF every step (145fe14c895d109e), flattening yr8 removes the shape trajectory (afa7f01995a9ce01).

SolveMode=DUTYCYCLE (Pascal SolveDuty, SolutionAlgs.pas:249): the distinguishing arms are ControlMode:=TIMEDRIVEN and DynaVars.h:=1.0 (a 1-second step, set_mode.rs:99) — IntervalHrs=h/3600 is tiny so the storage %stored barely moves; the load follows its `duty=` shape (CalcDutyMult) at the 1-second grid, pricesignal held constant. The 8 solves walk dc8 at seconds 1..8 (dblHour=n/3600). Oracle-validated: 8 converged steps, bit-identical across two processes (fc42b0d0bbecf307); feature-sensitive vs a flat dc8 (4b9c39449efb02f1).

DUTYCYCLE ControlMode:=TIMEDRIVEN interaction (set in Set_Mode for DUTY, set_mode.rs:99). Only under TIMEDRIVEN does the control queue honor a delay and fire on schedule: the recloser picks up on a temporary fault (applied 0.2s), trips FAST (0.4s), the fault self-clears below MinAmps, then RECLOSES on the recloseintervals schedule (0.9s) — a timed trip/reclose sequence. The deck does NOT set controlmode (the value under test is DUTY's default TIMEDRIVEN). Oracle-validated: 20 converged steps, bit-identical across two processes incl. eventlog+ctrlqueue (ea25e8d2106ac212); feature-sensitive vs `controlmode=static` (c0eb10198c3db72e — the timed reclose schedule collapses).

HARMONICMODE with DoAllHarmonics=No (Pascal SolveHarmonic, SolutionAlgs.pas:1011): `Set harmonics=(1 3 5 13)` takes the explicit-list branch (set_cmd.rs:443). h=1 -> the skip-fundamental gate + RetrieveSavedVoltages; h=13 -> a frequency ABSENT from sp5 (tops out at 11) -> a zero-injection SolveDirect at 780 Hz. Oracle-validated: converged, bit-identical across two processes (89f89055c9539085); feature-sensitive vs dropping h=13 (d51f6dd569d0d239 — the swept sample set changes).

HARMONICMODET / sequential-time harmonics (Pascal SolveHarmonicT, SolutionAlgs.pas:1097; port harmonics.rs solve_harmonic_t) — UNCOVERED elsewhere. number=3 time steps, each re-running InitializeForHarmonics + RetrieveSavedVoltages, then the DoAllHarmonics fan-out (final dblHour=2.0). Oracle-validated: converged, bit-identical across two processes (f7399d1723c2ce0a); feature-sensitive vs plain HARMONICMODE (d07a23557e25ffbf — the harmonicT dispatch itself is the pinned boundary). HONESTY NOTE (settle 2026-07-12, coordinator probe): the daily shape does NOT modulate the compared output on the oracle — flattening mult=(0.70 1.00 0.85) to (1 1 1) is bit-identical (fp 3988d1e53d8a27de both, incl. the monitor stream); the injection derives from the saved fundamental, so shape-sensitivity is NOT part of this deck's proof basis.

The Set_Mode RESET tail (Pascal Set_Mode, Solution.pas; port set_mode.rs): a daily solve (number=24) accumulates ~50 MWh in the meter and toggles the CapControl, then `Set mode=snapshot` fires the reset tail (ResetAll Monitors/EnergyMeters, DoResetFaults/Controls, intHour<-0, SolutionInitialized<-FALSE). The harness's snapshot solve then leaves the meter registers at their reset state (energy 0, Max sentinels -1e50; snapshot does not SampleTheMeters). Oracle-validated: converged, bit-identical across two processes (64f80ad6cb20dc09); feature-sensitive vs removing the mode change (34968c04b7e72ab3 — the harness solve continues the daily accumulation, meter kWh ~50600).

UPGRADE_PLAN WP-U1.8 (A2): WindGen snapshot power flow, wye. The aerodynamic steady-state Pm=0.5*rho*pi*Rad^2*vwind^3*Cp; at vwind=12 m/s the aero power (~2181 kW) curtails to kWBase=1500, so the WindGen injects -1500 kW at unity PF. Probed on capi015 (0.15.0b4): converged, w1 total P=-1500 kW; deterministic (pure power flow, no RNG). Feature-sensitive: the aero P(v^3) drives the whole injection, so any error in SetNominalGeneration moves the -1500 kW live compare far above the i_abs floor.

UPGRADE_PLAN WP-U1.8 (A2): WindGen snapshot, DELTA connection, PF=0.9. Exercises the delta YPrim (Y/3) + delta model current (L-N Vmag) + the QMode=0 PF reactive dispatch. Probed on capi015: converged, w1 total S=-1500 kW, -0 kvar (PF at unity here because the aero cap makes kvarCalc saturate). Deterministic. Feature-sensitive vs the wye deck (delta stamping path).

UPGRADE_PLAN WP-U1.8 (A2): WindGen DAILY mode -- the load shape supplies the WIND SPEED (m/s), not a per-unit multiplier (CalcDailyMult). At hour 1 the shape reads 10 m/s -> aero ~1263 kW (uncapped below kWBase=3000); exercises the daily-mode dispatch + shape-as-wind-speed path (distinct from the snapshot deck's default vwind). SINGLE-STEP (n_steps=1) by necessity: dss_capi 0.15.x caches per-element el.Losses and WindGen does not invalidate it across daily steps (delta bucket F 'cached total losses' -- Currents/Powers ARE fresh, only Losses freezes at step 0), so the corpus_live full-model losses channel would diverge on a multi-step deck. The port computes losses correctly; the bucket-F caching quirk is out of scope (not reproduced). The full 6-point wind sweep + cut-in/cut-out is pinned offline by the unit test aerodynamic_wind_speed_sweep. Probed on capi015: converged, hour-1 w1 total P matches.

UPGRADE_PLAN WP-U1.8 (A2/§1.7): WindGen WTG3 dynamics (the 50 us trapezoidal sub-cycle). At 0.69 kV so the WTG3 per-unit measurement (ratedKVll) is not saturated. One dynamics solve = 20x1ms outer steps; each corrector runs the full controller stack (PLL, seq-current PI regs, LVPL/LVQL, MPPT/torque/pitch/inertia, swing) over ~21 x 50 us sub-steps. Gated with compare_variables on ALL 22 state vars. Probed on capi015: converged; Pgen 1.0022, Qgen -0.0063, Vmag 1.0152, WtAct 1.19999, thetaPitch 4.377, Pg 1584 (kWBase re-derived kVA*PF), s -0.1388. Deterministic (no RNG; pure f64 sub-cycle).

UPGRADE_PLAN WP-U1.8 (A2/§1.7): WindGen WTG3 dynamics FAULT RIDE-THROUGH (LVPL/LVQL-sensitive). A sustained 3ph fault (Fault.f1 R=0.05) on the terminal depresses Vmag to ~0.90 pu through the run, engaging the low-voltage power-logic (LVPL curtailment) and reactive-logic (LVQL Iq limit). Probe-proven feature-sensitive on capi015: Vmag 0.898 (vs 1.015 healthy), Qgen +0.0712 (vs -0.0063 healthy -> reactive support), dOmg -0.081 (vs +0.010). 30x1ms steps; compare_variables all 22.
